newsitem.title: GERMANY: Morgan cuts 1997, 1998 EPS on Daimler.
newsitem.headline: Morgan cuts 1997, 1998 EPS on Daimler.

text.p: Morgan Stanley said on Friday that it has cut its 1997 and 1998 earnings outlook on German industrial group Daimler-Benz AG.
Morgan said in response to a Reuter enquiry that it cut Daimler's 1997 earnings outlook to 5.25 marks per share from 5.90 marks and the 1998 outlook to 7.40 marks from 7.90 marks.
The bank said it kept its rating on Daimler as neutral.
Daimler shares were down 3.85 marks at 149 marks while the blue-chip DAX index was up 15.19 points at 4,420.71 points in pre-bourse IBIS computer dealings.
